name: Finans: gider, kasa, sube secimi, borc odeme ve defter tutarliligi
description: Giris yapan hesap Finans iznine sahip olmalidir. Yalnizca TEST aciklamali gider ve borc olusturulur.

planSteps.description: Log in with the TEST account credentials configured for this project and open the Finance page (/finance)
Open the 'Kasa' tab and note the cash balance of the first branch
Open the 'Defter' tab, click '+ Gider', enter description 'TEST gider', amount 1500 and save
Verify the amount field showed 1.500 while typing and 'TEST gider' appears in the expense table of the ledger
Verify the branch cash balance decreased by exactly 1.500,00 compared to the earlier value
Open the 'Borclar' tab, add a debt titled 'TEST borc' with amount 40000 and save
Pay 10000 of the 'TEST borc' debt from the debts list
Verify the debt shows 10.000 paid and 30.000 remaining
Verify an expense named 'TEST borc' of 10.000,00 appears in the ledger expense list
Verify in the 'Borclar' tab the debt shows 0 paid and 40.000 remaining again
